description: This PHP source file defines the ConnectorFactory class, which provides methods to obtain connector instances and load connector classes dynamically based on class names and types in the SuiteCRM project.

classes.name: ConnectorFactory
classes.description: A factory class responsible for managing connector instances, including retrieving existing sources and dynamically loading source classes from various directories.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns an instance of a connector component for the given source name, creating and initializing it if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads the required class hierarchy for the given class name and type.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Includes the class file for a connector source based on the class name and type, searching in multiple directories.
